primitives.name: Observation-Centric Smoothing
primitives.verbatim_quote: Observation-Centric Online Smoothing rebuilds a virtual trajectory when a lost target is re-associated (prevents Kalman error accumulation under non-linear motion); Observation-Centric Momentum handles sudden direction changes; Observation-Centric Recovery associates an unassociated track's last observation with new detections to suppress spurious new tracklets.

primitives.assumptions: Motion dynamics follow piecewise linear approximations with abrupt changes modeled via momentum updates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-linear motion exceeding Kalman filter predictive capacity.

layer2.mapping: Enables robust tracking under high-acceleration motion by reconstructing past states from re-observed positions.
layer2.telemetry: HOTA score improvement from reduced false positive rate in occlusion scenarios.

primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Central distance recovery (§3.2):** when IoU-based recovery fails (fast players' boxes don't overlap), re-run recovery using Euclidean distance between detection centers and unassociated tracklets' last observations.

The core innovation lies in combining motion-first tracking with centralized spatial recovery mechanisms. The observation-centric smoothing addresses Kalman filter limitations under non-linear motion by rebuilding trajectories upon re-association, mitigating error propagation. Central distance recovery supplements traditional IoU-based methods with Euclidean geometry, enabling accurate tracking when bounding boxes do not overlap—critical for fast-moving athletes. Sport-specific ReID post-processing tailors identity management to each game’s unique dynamics: basketball caps identities, soccer uses multi-round appearance matching, and volleyball relies solely on distance. These primitives form a modular pipeline where each component compensates for the others’ weaknesses, ensuring robustness across diverse broadcast environments. Failure modes include misidentification under identical kit wear or insufficient feature diversity, which are addressed through layered validation and adaptive thresholds.
